statement: ∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (a : ℝ≥0), ((a : ℝ≥0∞) < dimH A → H (a : ℝ) A = ⊤) ∧ (H (a : ℝ) A = ⊤ → (a : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ dimH A)
proof:
intro X inst A a
letI : MeasurableSpace X := borel X
letI : BorelSpace X := ⟨rfl⟩
constructor
· intro h
  exact hausdorffMeasure_of_lt_dimH h
· intro h
  exact le_dimH_of_hausdorffMeasure_eq_top h
